acceptance_rule.initial: at least 3 official passes in 6 trials; external 33.3 percent is only a reference threshold
acceptance_rule.subsequent: strict pass-rate improvement and no per-task pass-rate regression against accepted local incumbent
acceptance_rule.no_accepted_candidate: retain bare H0 as unmeasured; report every measured candidate separately

local_baseline_plan: Do not run H0; user-specified external benchmark reference only
deliverable: Website documenting actual RSI process, candidate diffs, decisions, performance and costs
final_reporting: Freeze selected source and report its 3 trials per task from evolve; no additional baseline or held-out runs
